description.narrative: Based in Suriname, Stitching Projekta is a rights-based civil society organization focusing on the interlinkage between human rights, democracy and governance, with specific focus on women's rights and gender equality. As a rights-based organization, they look at processes in terms of duty bearers and rights holders and work with both sides to ensure the fulfillment of human rights for all. They enhance the substantial participation of women, youth and other underrepresented groups in the process of human development through rights-based programs aimed at increasing capacity, awareness, and voice in policy-making; and creating spaces for dialogue, among others. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries, bank fees, utilities, office rent, office supplies, equipment and other office-related costs, and training for their staff and members; - Meeting and workshop-related costs, including transportation, meals, materials, facilitators, and others; - Travel-related costs to attend regional meeting and workshops; - Advocacy materials and publicity and research-related costs.
